key_insight: GIFT filters token-level distillation using gradient geometry to retain teacher guidance that complements outcome-driven reinforcement learning.
engineering_relevance: For reasoning-model training, GIFT offers a principled way to allocate teacher supervision while reducing conflict with the RL objective.
method: Decompose each token’s distillation gradient into components parallel and orthogonal to the RL gradient.
Rank guidance by first-order conflict and novel directional value.
Progressively shrink distillation coverage, retaining selected updates at full strength and transitioning to pure RL.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistent improvements over strong baselines across mathematical and logical reasoning benchmarks and multiple model scales, with relative gains up to 9.5% on difficult math tasks.
watch_item: Token-level gradient analysis may add training overhead; the abstract does not quantify its computational cost.
paper_title: GIFT: Gradient Informed Filtering for Distillation Augmented Reasoning RL
